fusions.name: Armful of Sod
fusions.desc: Hurls a torn-up slab of sod that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Two-Fisted Slam
fusions.desc: Brings the flat of the blade down with both fists, dealing 16 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Haft Catch
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds you catch blows on the haft and wrench back: 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Navvy's Shoulders

riders.text: a day of digging stops tiring you
the tool moves faster in your hands
and the blisters close by morning

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your stamina recovers 10% faster, from silver you attack 6% faster, and from gold your health recovers 10% faster.
